description:
Your swipe file: the title structures of the Packaging finds you kept or filed, each
    title_template with its title_device, count (how many of those videos use it, one a
    video) and best (the example with the highest outlier_score, 0 to 100). The most used
    first; packages is how many videos were read, skipped how many had no structure. Same
    as GET /v1/swipe. Free.
name: swipe_file
